name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A system that teaches AI coding assistants a disciplined way of working: plan first, write tests, build in small verified steps, and never skip the review.
buyer: An engineering lead at a software consultancy who sells AI-assisted development work and needs the output to be consistently reliable, not just fast.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes this methodology across every client project so AI-written code ships at a predictable quality bar they can bill confidently for.
A freelance developer sells a 'get your AI coding agent set up properly' half-day consulting package to other solo devs and small teams.
A coding bootcamp or corporate training program teaches this framework as the 'how to actually use AI coding agents professionally' module.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid 'AI coding methodology setup' consulting package to dev shops and solo freelancers.
Run a paid cohort-based course teaching teams how to adopt this workflow.

steal_this: Package a half-day 'AI coding methodology setup' consulting offer and pitch it to three local dev shops this week.
